transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for making time on short notice. As you know, a former sales executive left last week and joined a direct competitor, and we believe confidential customer information may have been used after the departure. We could be looking at a preliminary-injunction hearing within three weeks. Our draft filing currently seeks broad relief covering customer information, pricing materials, and source-code documentation. Before I sign off on the filing decision, I need each of you to report any material issue in your area. Let's start with employment counsel -- what do we need to know on the employment side?
